title: POV — How to Use Third Person Omniscient
skills: identify third-person omniscient point of view
distinguish omniscient narration from limited narration
analyze how an omniscient narrator reveals multiple perspectives
use omniscient narration intentionally in narrative writing
alignment_note: Explains how third-person omniscient narration allows a narrator to access the thoughts, experiences, and perspectives of multiple characters. Supports point-of-view analysis, narrative voice, perspective comparison, and intentional use of omniscient narration across high school English and creative writing courses.
